specs: Captain Dave builds custom rods used on trips
No marking shoes; acceptable are sneakers, boat shoes, or flip flops with light colored soles

services.name: Fishing Charter
services.desc: Chasin’ Dreams Sportfishing is a small family business started by a guy wanting to do more of what he loves and to share that passion with others. Everyone has the “dream” to do what they love and that is what Captain Dave gets to do with this

includes: Rods, tackle and fishing licenses included
Coolers on board to keep your catch fresh
Porti-pot and toilet paper available on board
gap: Exact prices for half day and full day charters not stated on site
blurb: Fishing charters on Upper Chesapeake Bay with Captain Dave.
extraNote: Fishing at Captain’s discretion for weather; will try to reschedule if conditions are bad · No refunds once the boat leaves the dock · No drugs or medical marijuana allowed onboard · Porter’s Seneca Marina, 918 Seneca Park Rd, Middle River (Bowleys Quarters), MD 21220 · April to December
